pages.text: Combine one iron ingot and one slimeball without a fixed shape.
Use the tuner on your companion within eight blocks. Manage names, points, orders, equipment, and cargo. Keep the tuner in either hand while the screen is open.
The Creative Slime Tuner edits base stats and current resources in Creative only. It has no Survival recipe. Shrinking Capacity requires emptying the slots that would be lost.
